sources.citation: Stanislas Dehaene, Jean-Pierre Changeux, Lionel Naccache, Jérôme Sackur et al. (2006). Conscious, preconscious, and subliminal processing: a testable taxonomy. Trends in Cognitive Sciences.
sources.notes: Foundational primary study (2006) in Trends in Cognitive Sciences establishing the core experimental paradigm and quantitative parameters.

sources.citation: George A. Mashour, Pieter Roelfsema, Jean-Pierre Changeux, Stanislas Dehaene (2020). Conscious Processing and the Global Neuronal Workspace Hypothesis. Neuron.
sources.notes: Subsequent empirical and theoretical investigation (2020) in Neuron extending the foundational findings.

sources.citation: Antoine Del Cul, Sylvain Baillet, Stanislas Dehaene (2007). Brain Dynamics Underlying the Nonlinear Threshold for Access to Consciousness. PLoS Biology.
sources.notes: Backward-masking ERP study demonstrating linear early visual progression followed by an abrupt ~270–300 ms nonlinear P3b frontoparietal ignition threshold.

sources.citation: Oscar Ferrante, Urszula Górska, Simon E. Henin, Rony Hirschhorn, Aya F. Khalaf et al. (2025). Adversarial testing of global neuronal workspace and integrated information theories of consciousness. Nature.
sources.notes: Cogitate Consortium multimodal fMRI, MEG, and intracranial EEG adversarial test challenging both GNW offset-ignition and IIT posterior-synchrony predictions.

sources.citation: Lionel Naccache, Stanislas Dehaene (2007). Reportability and illusions of phenomenality in the light of the global neuronal workspace model. Behavioral and Brain Sciences.
sources.notes: Subsequent empirical and theoretical investigation (2007) in Behavioral and Brain Sciences extending the foundational findings.
